no_adcom_quote.quote: This BLA was not presented at an Advisory Committee because the application did not raise significant safety or efficacy issues that were unexpected for a biologic of this class.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for Praxbind (idarucizumab, BLA761025). The Summary Review (L51), Cross-Discipline Team Leader review (L167), and Office Director Memo (L54) all state the BLA was not presented at an advisory committee because the application did not raise significant unexpected safety or efficacy issues for a biologic of this class. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
